modules.name: wisp-model
modules.responsibility: Owns stable domain identifiers, artifact records, and persistence receipts shared across Wisp layers.

modules.name: wisp-schema
modules.responsibility: Owns the embedded, version-pinned artifact contract registry and JSON validation.

modules.name: wisp-artifacts
modules.responsibility: Owns canonical artifact paths, validation-backed persistence and retrieval, graph discovery, local Git-state evidence, and explicit selected plan/spec context assembly.

modules.name: wisp-cli
modules.responsibility: Provides the command-line boundary, input handling, JSON results, and human diagnostics by calling the domain crates.

modules.name: wisp-fixtures
modules.responsibility: Provides shared support for black-box fixture tests; it is not a runtime service layer.

canonical_abstractions.rationale: Validate artifact IDs once before they participate in canonical workspace paths.

canonical_abstractions.concept: Identity and canonical location of a supported schema contract
canonical_abstractions.rationale: Use the typed contract identity for registry operations instead of passing contract names as unvalidated strings.

canonical_abstractions.concept: Bounded implementation context for an explicit task or batch
canonical_abstractions.rationale: Validate and project only the selected plan/spec chain without whole-graph discovery, Git inspection, or derived-state writes.

invariants.name: Domain model independence
invariants.rule: wisp-model must not depend on another Wisp crate.
invariants.rationale: Shared domain contracts remain usable by every adapter without creating an upward dependency.

invariants.name: Pinned offline schema contracts
invariants.rule: Runtime artifact validation uses embedded, versioned schemas and does not resolve schemas from a mutable external checkout.
invariants.rationale: Validation must not change based on a mutable external checkout or require network access.
invariants.enforced_by: The include_str! schema registry in crates/wisp-schema/src/lib.rs embeds schemas at compile time.

invariants.name: Wisp does not commit artifacts
invariants.rule: Artifact persistence may write canonical files but must not create Git commits.
invariants.rationale: The caller retains control of review and repository history.

invariants.name: Implementation context is a selected-chain read
invariants.rule: Implementation-context assembly reads only the explicitly selected plan, its linked spec, and metadata for declared task paths; it does not discover the artifact graph, inspect Git, write derived state, or imply approval or code completeness.
invariants.rationale: The first handoff removes deterministic plan/spec checks from the agent loop while keeping its scope bounded and its claims evidence-based.
invariants.enforced_by: assemble_implementation_context in crates/wisp-artifacts/src/implementation_context.rs and its isolated temporary-workspace tests.

invariants.name: Keep library errors independent of the JSON envelope
invariants.rule: The Rust API accepts a typed selector-plus-ID and returns a Rust error; only the CLI maps failures to implementation-context@1 JSON.
invariants.rationale: Rust callers should not depend on a transport-specific failure envelope.
invariants.enforced_by: ImplementationContextError's Error-bound test and the wisp-cli integration tests.

invariants.name: Bound artifact reads before parsing
invariants.rule: Each selected plan and spec read, including stability rereads, must stop at 1,048,576 bytes plus one detection byte and reject overflow before parsing.
invariants.rationale: A bounded output does not bound memory used to read and parse an oversized source.
